intro_line: Where prairie energy meets Rocky Mountain skyline.
intro: Calgary rewards visitors with a walkable downtown, big-league food and a mountain horizon at every turn. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
transit_facts: CTrain light rail runs two lines (Red and Blue) through downtown on 7th Avenue South, which is transit-only.
Calgary Transit buses fill the gaps; a single fare is about $4 adult, $2.65 youth, free for ages 12 and under.
Taxis are metered; Uber is the main ride-hailing app and the only one authorized at the airport.
Driving is easy outside rush hour; downtown parking is expensive, so use park-and-ride at suburban stations.
Downtown is compact and walkable; the Bow River pathways are good for bikes and rentals.
No ferries; the city is inland.

airports.name: Calgary International Airport
airports.note: Main gateway, about 8 km straight-line and roughly 18 km by road northeast of the centre.

options.note: Runs every 30 min from 5:30am to midnight; buy via My Fare app or ticket machine.
